Product Overview:
This collection features a variety of vintage tobacco smoking pipes with distinct shapes and finishes. Included is a Lucienne-branded pipe with a faceted octagonal bowl and bent black stem, along with other pipes exhibiting rustic, smooth, lacquered, and carved textured designs.

Specifications:
- Lucienne logo on black stem
- Faceted octagonal bowl design
- Bent stem on Lucienne pipe
- Rustic natural wood finish with long unfinished shank
- Smooth brown finish pipe
- Red lacquered pipe with black mouthpiece marked 'E'
- Carved textured pipe with dark reddish finish
- Materials likely include briar or hardwood
- Pre-owned condition with visible signs of use
- Stems and bowls structurally intact

The samples range from crystalline to metallic-looking stones, all in raw, unpolished condition. Each compartment holds a unique piece, organized for easy viewing. 281100855.description: This vintage collection includes seven small clear specimen containers, each holding a different mineral or rock sample in colors such as clear, amber, green, brown, and yellow. The containers and lids show signs of age and dust accumulation, suggesting long-term storage. Additionally, there is one larger loose mineral specimen that is rough, translucent, and light pink in color, possibly rose quartz. No brand or manufacturer markings are visible on any of the items.
